merge_rule.description: For each field, prefer non-null observations; among them prefer the model's own page (exact URL slug), then the latest fetched_at instant. Break ties by source URL and page SHA256 in ascending order. Null-only fields stay null. Fetch time is an observation-time tie-break, not proof of AA revision age. Record every unequal observation, including null versus populated values.
